children: Better Home & Finance Holding began an options program within its $30 million stock buyback authorization, initially capped at $1 million in net cash expenditures.
The program allows the company to purchase call options and sell put options on its Class A common stock.
The initial aggregate net cash expenditure limit is $1 million, including premiums and exercise or settlement amounts, net of receipts.
The company began entering into program transactions on November 11, 2026; it is not obligated to enter into transactions.
Options may expire without value or result in losses; the company may modify, suspend or discontinue new transactions.
